payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force search downwards from y within a window of size up to 1000, checking each number for divisibility by integers up to min(p, sqrt(n)).
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates candidates in descending order and tests each with trial division; it uses bounded exhaustive search typical of complete search, though specific subtype like search_backtracking is a loose fit due to the iterative early-exit from inner loop upon finding a divisor.
